identity.note: "Pain" is a generic gimmick name this hobby reused freely. The WeWF's own 1991 standings carry a wrestler of the same name in the same community and window, and the two federations demonstrably shared talent — but nothing beyond the bare name ties them, and a bare name never joins. Filed distinct under the no-merge default; the WeWF adjacency is recorded here rather than acted on.
